 I was distressed to read that JD Vance's fraud squad recently reported $42 million in stolen benefits from the SNAP program. In denouncing the fraudsters, JD had harsh words for those who "... will steal from the mouths of hungry children to enrich themselves." I wholeheartedly agree. People who take food from hungry children are among the most despicable of humans.
 So how are we to assess the moral standing of those Republicans who took food "out of the mouths" of a million children as a result of their reductions to SNAP benefits? Between 3.5 and 4 million people have lost their SNAP benefits as a result of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act — including over a million children.
 Please note that the fraud reported by Vance's “fraud squad” was not committed by low-income SNAP recipients but by store owners and other scammers involved in administering the program. Granted, $42 million is a big number and any such fraud is too much, but it represents only about 0.014% of SNAP outlays over the same period .
 Meanwhile, the IRS and GAO (Government Accountability Office) estimate that tax fraud and evasion by high-income ($10 million-plus) households accounts for hundreds of billions of dollars a year. We're not talking about legal tax avoidance but outright fraud. Those folks also are taking food out of the mouths of hungry children.
 Tom St.Clair
 Decorah
